sys_atf_test.description: Creates a case funded 60 percent general revenue and 40 percent federal, then asserts a row-by-row sum of funding_pct equals 100 — the calculation ITF Submission Validation performs before allowing certification. Guards against reverting to GlideAggregate SUM, which was measured returning 40.00 for this exact split and would reject a legitimately funded request.
sys_atf_test.name: Funding percentages on an uneven split total 100 when summed row by row
